answer: A farm of 54 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are logged in nebula, queued in whisper, and walnut publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 92 identities per epoch. A farm of 681 identities would post 4557 proofs and burn roughly 30 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
